decision: Accept bounded rotating-family review; resume only the existing cellular-tracer package, after preserving its stopped checkpoint.
basis: Rotating r2 completed exactly three model trials: two physical passes and one mixed failure; zero clean physical failures.
Both passing solutions identify the compliant thermostat and its local heat; the failing attempt also used the correct heat law but omitted a spring self-force in its scratch drift.

Reviewed same-family parameter, anisotropy and Gaussian-mode extensions retain the demonstrated physical law. Heat-variance extensions overlap an already solved archived task. No complete alternative nonlinear apparatus has been established.
This supports no immediate r3, not a claim that all future rotating tasks are easy.
Cellular tracer is an existing bounded prototype with independent scientific review; no unrelated search is authorized by this decision.
scope: Complete scientific package, domain/reference/noise checks and independent final peer review only.

Keep priority model queue rod r4, hydrodynamic r3, then already accepted pulse-block and adiabatic replacements. Cellular evaluation remains after those priorities and requires a separate frozen plan.
Do not change canonical tasks or run any new model evaluation as part of packaging.
